slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the number of trained pilots produced in a given year equal to the number of fighter jets allocated to training that year, or is there a different conversion rate or training duration that affects how many pilots are available by the end of year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the conversion rate for turning training jets into trained pilots, which is the per-jet training capacity.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 5 pilots per year rate applied to each training jet for the full year, meaning a jet allocated to training in year 1 produces 5 pilots by the end of year 1 and a jet allocated in year 2 produces 5 pilots by the end of year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked directly about the timing and duration of training, including whether one year of training yields pilots by the end of that year, which targets the training-duration hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot and P1 training-duration/timing slot were raised and answered before READY_TO_MODEL; only the P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping was unasked, which does not block the objective.

summary: The agent recovered the critical training-capacity and training-timing facts through direct questions, though it did not ask the low-impact pilot-to-combat-jet mapping. It stopped after resolving the P0/P1 issues, making the stop appropriate.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
